purpose: Identify every current owner, credential reference, migration, job, route, readback and recovery dependency reachable by the three admitted Luzione CRM OS golden journeys before any activation decision.
requested_from: L2 CRM domain and UI owner

one_row_per_reachable_component.credential_rule: Record only a secret manager or workload-identity reference and principal/service mapping; never include a secret value.

required_negative_and_readback_evidence: missing, revoked, expired and wrong-tenant identity denial
surplus, missing and wrong contract version denial
same-key exact replay and changed-payload conflict
stale source version and ambiguous provider result
no credential value or PII egress
provider acknowledgement distinguished from source-confirmed finality
zero effects while feature flags are disabled
recovery proof bound to exact migrations and candidate SHA
acceptance_rule: No omission or UNKNOWN authorizes activation. Inventory returns are evidence inputs only and require controller review plus the applicable G1/G2 gates.
